implementation.backend: none; all assets, rig fitting, pointer rules and state run locally
implementation.body: Quaternius CC0 complete 53-bone stylized mannequin, not a real-person scan
implementation.poseSampling: matching constant clips on independently cloned full skins, mixer.setTime(0); no live animation phase
implementation.pick: nearest visible registered gallery garment mesh, excluding invisible ancestors
implementation.drop: nearest visible avatar/worn-cloth mesh hit in registered local chest/abdomen box
implementation.preview: temporary visual garment only; stable config remains entire original baseline until legal release
implementation.slot: one complete upper garment; switching garment/color does not change body pose or camera
implementation.fabric: only Fitting_Fabric recolored; trim, stitching and metal materials remain independent
implementation.units: uncalibrated scene units; 1.78 reference is virtual normalization, not a measured person or size recommendation
